andrew-young.name: Andrew Young
andrew-young.bioHtml:
Andrew Young is a writer / composer / actor / comedian / pianist based in Los Angeles. He's written and performed with Quick & Funny Musicals since 2019.

He trained in film direction and production at the University of North Carolina School of the Arts and studied comedy at Second City and the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre, where he now teaches Musical Improv. He is also a regular performer at UCB with his musical improv teams Candy Apple Red and Sweet Sweet Fantasy Musical.

He is co-creator of Dramatique! - The Sung-Through Musical. He has performed and taught improv around the world. He also works as a musical director and accompanist for theater and improv.

Select theater credits: Real Housewives Unauthorized Musical Parody (Dynasty Typewriter, Los Angeles), Dear Jerry Seinfeld (Joe Davola, Three Clubs Los Angeles), Beauty and the Beast (Lefou, NC Regional), The Wizard of Oz (Cowardly Lion, NC Regional), 1776 (Samuel Chase, NC Regional)

IG: @androssthegreat // andrewmarkyoung.com

He's never gone viral, but he did catch Covid to feel included.

dahlya-glick.name: Dahlya Glick
dahlya-glick.bioHtml:
Dahlya Glick is an artist of all sorts based in Los Angeles and thrilled to be performing in their first Edinburgh Fringe show! They have been a writer and performer with Quick & Funny Musicals since 2019.

Select theater credits: A Transparent Musical (Center Theatre Group), A Wicked Soul in Cherry Hill (The Geffen Playhouse), Emojiland.

Select TV: Awkwafina, Scream Queens, Spongebob, Perry Mason.

Check out their original music under Dahlya Mani on all platforms.

IG: @oprahwinfreckle // dahlyaglick.com

ellie-diberardino.name: Ellie DiBerardino
ellie-diberardino.bioHtml:
Ellie DiBerardino is a writer and interactive experience designer (think video games meet immersive theater) with a background in music, film, and math.

With a highly collaborative directorial style and an unrelenting attention to detail, she is uniquely able to execute on complex creative visions that often ask audiences to reexamine their fundamental belief systems. She draws inspiration from psychological experiments, logical paradoxes, musical theater, and potatoes.

She has worked with artists from Reggie Watts to Gaelynn Lea, and with companies from Frito Lay to Intel. Her work has been nominated for a PGA Innovation Award and written up in the San Francisco Chronicle.

Her prior career has run the gamut, from advertising strategy to statistics education, anything that lets her flex both sides of her brain and imbue her work with personality and flair. She currently uses her daytime brain at Apple working as an instructional designer for pro video apps.

Ellie is based in Los Angeles, with frequent stints in San Francisco and a secret location in the rural Maine woods.

IG: @l.e.d.bear

gabe-greenspan.name: Gabe Greenspan
gabe-greenspan.bioHtml:
Gabe Greenspan is a Los Angeles-based actor who graduated from Yale University with a BA in Theatre Studies.

He co-founded the sketch comedy group The Idiot Chimney and co-created the Freeform digital series Dinner With Dad with his father, Jason Alexander.

Gabe is a member of UCB's Quick & Funny Musicals and performs with many indie improv teams around Los Angeles, musical and otherwise. He has studied at Lesly Kahn & Co. in Hollywood and under the tutelage of Larry Moss.

He has also trained in and taught circus for many years at the French Woods Festival of the Performing Arts.

IG: @gabespan

gwen-hollander.name: Gwen Hollander
gwen-hollander.bioHtml:
Gwen Hollander has appeared in recurring roles on Showtime's Kidding (with Jim Carrey) and Hulu's Future Man (with Seth Rogen and Josh Hutcherson).

Film: Marriage Material (Searchlight Pictures, Best Actress, Florida Comedy Film Festival), T-R-O-U-B-L-E! starring Anthony Rapp.

Some favorite theatre credits include the Broadway and national tour of Little Women (Amy, Carbonell Award), Les Miserables (Eponine, Carbonell Award), Beauty and the Beast (Belle), Avenue Q (Kate Monster / Lucy T. Slut), and Urinetown (Hope).

Her parody music videos have been regularly featured on Whohaha. She performs with Quick & Funny Musicals in Los Angeles monthly.

IG: @gwenstagram811

henry-kaiser.name: Henry Kaiser
henry-kaiser.bioHtml:
Henry Kaiser was at the Fringe Festival many years ago as a VIP room bouncer for Assembly Rooms. He is now very happy to be performing at the Fringe Festival, at the rival Gilded Balloon!

He starred in the film Detective Detective Detective! He has performed off-Broadway in Who Loves You, Baby?, about Telly Savalas, as Telly's brother George, directed by Taylor Negron.

He was also a part of the ARACA Project's off-Broadway workshops of The Odyssey: An Epic New Musical.

He very much looks forward to a beautiful month in the land of his grandfather's family, the MacQuarries.

IG: @henrykaiser

isabella-gerasole.name: Isabella Gerasole
isabella-gerasole.bioHtml:
Isabella “Izzy G” Gerasole is a comedian and James Beard Award winner from Chicago.

Recent credits include The Pansexual Bachelor (Elysian Theater, winner), Funny or Die Lab Cycle Series 1 (Dynasty Typewriter), and She's Loud, He's Quiet! (Elysian Theater).

You can see her performing standup all around the city and in her monthly show Joy's Bed & Breakfast (Elysian Theater). She writes and performs regularly with Quick & Funny Musicals at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theater.

IG: @isabellagerasole

jaime-ary.name: Jaime Ary
jaime-ary.bioHtml:
Jaime Ary (also known as DarylJim Diaz) is a Los Angeles-based actor, comedian, and content creator.

He's trained at the Upright Citizens Brigade, World's Greatest Improv School, and the American Musical and Dramatic Academy. Known for his work in live comedy and independent films, he is a regular performer at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre in Los Angeles. He performs with comedy groups such as Filipino AF and frequently produces and hosts comedy and improv shows in Los Angeles. He performs regularly with Quick & Funny Musicals.

Ary has appeared in short films and streaming series, with credits including Me Night (2024), Love & Karma, and Served Cold. You may also have seen him in Patreon, Sam's Club Holiday, and Credit Karma commercials and ads, or in the 2018 Oscars performance of This Is Me from The Greatest Showman.

He is also an accomplished photographer.

He is represented by Aqua Talent and Stone Talent Agency.

IG: @jamie_ary

jenna-bryson.name: Jenna Bryson
jenna-bryson.bioHtml:
Jenna Bryson is an actor, comedy improviser (UCB, Second City), writer, director, and singer-songwriter with film / TV placements.

In 2023, she joined the Quick & Funny Musicals team at the UCB Theatre in Los Angeles, and she is a founding producer of The Harold Experience, a monthly indie improv show. She cut her teeth as a performer on the Los Angeles princess party circuit, and yes, she has tons of celebrity party stories and, yes, story rights are available.

She self-published her debut children's book Grace from Outer Space thanks to nearly 500 Kickstarter backers pre-ordering $19K in book sales. She's working to develop the girl-powered STEM concept as a collection of books and animated series.

Jenna also co-created, co-produced, and directed episodes of the viral parody web series According to Kids, which has racked up over 10 million views. Jenna writes solo, as well as with writing partner Eric Scott. Their pilot Storybook Village was a quarterfinalist in ScreenCraft's 2021 Sci-Fi / Fantasy contest, and she loves producing / directing funny shorts as Bryson & Kaye alongside her comedy wife Josie Kaye.

She credits her grandmother, a Filipina who acted in golden-era movies that filmed in the Philippines, with giving her the bug for entertainment.

IG: @jennabryson // jennabryson.com

joy-regullano.name: Joy Regullano
joy-regullano.bioHtml:
Joy Regullano is a writer / actor / comedian based in Los Angeles who wrote on the animated show MONSTERS AT WORK (based on MONSTERS INC) on Disney Plus.

Previously, she wrote on JELLY, BEN, and POGO (a PBS Kids web series), KUNG FU PANDA: DRAGON KNIGHT (Netflix / Dreamworks), HEALING POWERS OF DUDE (Netflix), several Sesame Workshop digital shorts, and she was a Sesame Street writing fellow.

TV acting credits include BARRY, LINCOLN LAWYER, CRAZY EX-GIRLFRIEND, MODERN FAMILY, SPEECHLESS, and SUPERNATURAL. She has performed improv and sketch around Los Angeles at UCB and Second City Hollywood.

Her YouTube sketch WHITE FETISH went viral (1M+ views) and was featured in the Huffington Post, Upworthy, and more. She was recently nominated for an Emmy for writing on Sesame Street's Word of the Day series.

Check out the concept album for her Asian American comedy musical SUPPORTIVE WHITE PARENTS, now available on all streaming platforms!

IG: @joyregullano

krystle-simmons.name: Krystle Simmons
krystle-simmons.bioHtml:
Krystle Simmons is an award-winning singer / actress with an easy urban sparkle.

Born and raised in Atlanta, Georgia, Krystle Simmons has been dancing and singing since she was two years old. Singing has carried her all over the world, from the deserts of Namibia, the castles of Russia, the beaches of the Caribbean, and on stages across the United States.

She sang on the OCTANE album by Don Toliver, which peaked at No. 1 on the Billboard charts. She is also an NAACP Award nominee for Best Female Actress in a Musical for Memphis (MTW). She also has a BS in Biology from Life University.

Check out her album Standards to Cover (2014) on all streaming platforms.

Select TV / Theater Credits: Jesus Christ Superstar (Hollywood Bowl), Wicked: One Wonderful Night (NBC), Come From Away (La Mirada Theatre), The Christians (Center Theatre Group), California Dreaming (National Tour), Sophisticated Ladies (Atlanta Lyric), Ragtime (Atlanta Lyric).

IG: @the_krystle_simmons // krystlesimmons.squarespace.com

larry-saperstein.name: Larry Saperstein
larry-saperstein.bioHtml:
Larry Saperstein is a multi-talented entertainer known for his work as an actor, tap dancer, and creative.

He gained widespread recognition as Big Red in the 11-time Emmy-nominated series High School Musical: The Musical: The Series on Disney+, which ran for four seasons from 2019 to 2023. He has also appeared in the SXSW horror-comedy feature Porno, BET+'s First Wives Club, and Freeform's Fan Girl.

Formally trained in dance and voice, he starred in several regional musical productions at a young age, including the classics Oliver!, Miracle on 34th Street, and Fiddler on the Roof. He received his early dance training with the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theatre and the American Tap Dance Foundation in NYC.

In 2022, Saperstein launched an in-depth tap dance masterclass series entitled Tap With Larry, teaching foundational tap dance skills to new dancers. He currently performs monthly with Quick & Funny Musicals at UCB Franklin in Los Angeles.

IG: @larrysaperstein

lindsey-ford.name: Lindsey Ford
lindsey-ford.bioHtml:
Lindsey Moore Ford, actor and singer, was born and raised in Atlanta, Georgia. She grew up frequently performing on the stage of the nationally acclaimed Alliance Theatre Company.

During her many performances there, she was blessed to be under the direction of Kenny Leon, David H. Bell, and others. In high school, she also toured regionally with The Atlanta Workshop Players.

She continued her studies at Yale, where she double majored in Theatre and American Studies. She was in numerous theatrical productions during her time at Yale and also served as the musical director of Shades, an internationally known a cappella group. As a member of Shades, she performed in Japan, Puerto Rico, and South Africa.

Since moving to Los Angeles, Lindsey has been taking classes at UCB and Lesly Kahn. She has been in several theatrical productions and short films. You can currently see her as Skye in the Wonderstv.com web series Forever Summer. She can be seen performing regularly with Quick & Funny Musicals. She's also a Story Pirate!

IG: @thelindseylife

marnina-schon.name: Marnina Schon
marnina-schon.bioHtml:
Marnina Schon is an actor, singer, violinist and writer based in Los Angeles.

Marnina is half of musical comedy duo Couplet (@coupletcomedy) with their romantic and creative partner, Micah O'Konis. Couplet has quickly grown a fanbase online and in person, touring their award-winning show Honey Honey Moon Moon to New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, Boston, and London, and making their Edinburgh Fringe and BBC premiere last year to wide acclaim (“so charming!” ***** - Ed Fest Mag, “wild” ***** - Starburst Mag). They are returning to the Fringe this year with their new show Folk Marry Kill at Assembly.

As an actor, Marnina starred in the dramedy series Chanshi (featuring Henry Winkler), an Official Sundance Selection. Marnina has performed in countless theater productions in the Los Angeles area (South Coast Rep, Laguna Playhouse), and originated roles in staged readings at Center Theatre Group, The Wilshire Ebell, and the Geffen Playhouse. Critics have called their performances “quirky perfection” (StageSceneLA) and “most interesting...I wish she had more stage time” (Broadway World). You may have also seen Marnina ruining Kat Dennings's date on Hulu's Dollface, hacky-sackying to the delight of Fred Armisen and the dismay of Sian Clifford on Netflix's Unstable, creating sketch videos with the likes of Josh Gad and Seth Rogen, goofing with comedy icons like Paul Scheer and Rachel Bloom in The Muppets Script, and jumping into the wackiest of roles with Quick & Funny Musicals' revolving door of original musicals at Upright Citizens Brigade or The Elysian each month. You can spot them fiddling on cult-favorite Dropout shows Game Changer and Play It By Ear. You can also hear them on Good Guy with a Gun!, a new musical comedy album (featuring Chris Sullivan, Kimiko Glenn, Anthony Rapp, Jason Alexander, and more). Marnina has also sold their soul to be in some national commercials.

IG: @marninaschon // marninaschon.com

matthew-patrick-davis.name: Matthew Patrick Davis
matthew-patrick-davis.bioHtml:
Matthew Patrick Davis is an actor / songwriter / musician who most recently portrayed The Mother in 20th Century Studios' hit horror film Barbarian.

As a songwriter, he has co-written and produced songs for the upcoming season of The Ghost and Molly McGee on Disney Channel and RoboGobo, Pupstruction, and T.O.T.S. on Disney Junior alongside series songwriter Rob Cantor, and for Red Fish Blue Fish on Netflix. He also co-wrote Hulk-Sized with TJ Hill for Iron Man & His Awesome Friends on Disney Junior.

He was also commissioned to write a children's album, I Love My Dog, for the screen-free audio device YOTO Player. He's written music and lyrics for a number of comedic songs and musicals for Quick & Funny Musicals at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre, the San Francisco SketchFest, and his YouTube channel, including most recently PUN-OFF: A Musical Inside the High-Stakes World of Pun Competitions. His YouTube video Nightmare Before Christmas Live has over 5M views and counting.

As an actor, he made his Broadway debut in the musical revival Side Show, directed by Bill Condon.

Select Television Credits: Brett on Greek, David Chapman on Days of Our Lives

Select Theater Credits: Emperor Joseph II in Amadeus (Pasadena Playhouse), Tim Allgood in Noises Off (The Old Globe), Lieutenant Eunuch in The Nightingale and Tom Snout in A Midsummer Night's Dream (La Jolla Playhouse), Norton in South Street (Pasadena Playhouse), Protean in A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum and Alex/Others in Sunday in the Park with George (Reprise Theatre), Duckworth/Others in Project: Wonderland (Bootleg Theater), Accordion Man in A Cat Wrote This Play (Sacred Fools Theater), Emcee in Buddy: The Buddy Holly Story (San Francisco Playhouse), and Richard Henry Lee in 1776 (Lamb's Players Theatre)

IG: @matthewpatrickdavis // matthewpatrickdavis.com

micah-okonis.name: Micah O'Konis
micah-okonis.bioHtml:
Micah O'Konis is a writer, composer and comedian based in Los Angeles.

Micah is half of musical comedy duo Couplet (@coupletcomedy) with their romantic and creative partner, Marnina Schon. Couplet has quickly grown a fanbase online and in person, touring their award-winning show Honey Honey Moon Moon to New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, Boston, and London, and making their Edinburgh Fringe and BBC premiere last year to wide acclaim (“so charming!” ***** - Ed Fest Mag, “wild” ***** - Starburst Mag). They are returning to the Fringe this year with their new show Folk Marry Kill at Assembly.

As an artist, Micah writes, composes, and accompanies for Quick & Funny Musicals. They compose music for films and commercials, release soft indie folk music under the artist name Lookalike, and wrote the award-winning musical comedy More Guns! with Philip Labes. The musical, now titled Good Guy With A Gun (@goodguymusical), has been recorded as a full-length concept album starring Anthony Rapp, Chris Sullivan, Kimiko Glenn, Kristen Schall, and Vic Michaelis. It's slated for release this July.

Their music has been featured on FX and in a national campaign for the city of San Francisco, and their song Hot Hanukkah was reposted by P!NK.

IG: @micahokgood

molly-moseley.name: Molly Moseley
molly-moseley.bioHtml:
Molly Moseley was a staff writer on CALL ME KAT (FOX) and on Robert Zemeckis' TOONED OUT (Max).

Raised in Boston, she got a BFA in acting from NYU's Tisch School of the Arts before moving to Los Angeles, where she honed her comedy skills at The Comedy Store, The Groundlings, and UCB.

After amassing millions of views creating content for Funny or Die and McSweeney's, Molly was a Just For Laughs New Face Creator and was selected for the Warner Brothers Writers' Workshop.

She was also a SoulCycle instructor for several years... which was weird. Ask her about it!

IG: @itsmollymoseley

nohely-quiroz.name: Nohely Quiroz
nohely-quiroz.bioHtml:
Nohely Quiroz is an actress-stunt woman and producer for stage and screen. She is straight off a two-month stint sawing a magician in half across the Caribbean and is the director of Odie's World, the children's animated podcast with 3 million views, where she also voices Roey.

On television: Women in Blue (Apple TV), Better Call Saul (AMC), Monsters at Work (Disney+), On Call (Amazon), NCIS (CBS), and The Snowball Protocol (Disney+). She was recently honoring Chita Rivera at Carnegie Hall, singing alongside Melissa Errico, Liz Callaway, and Charlotte d'Amboise. After Edinburgh Fringe, you can catch her 54 Below directorial debut for EARTHA! on August 26 in New York City.

Regular performer for Quick & Funny Musicals. Past theater credits: Tai (UMPO Clueless), Rita (UMPO Bridesmaids), Magenta (Rocky Horror), Extraordinary Girl (Green Day's American Idiot), Georgie (Full Monty), and Rusty (Footloose).

IG: @nohelyviquiroz

randi-dimarco.name: Randi DeMarco
randi-dimarco.bioHtml:
Randi DeMarco is a singer, actor, writer, and proud Los Angeles native!

She has been seen on stage throughout Los Angeles and across the country, including The Secret Garden at the Ahmanson and Oliver! (5 Star Theatricals). She also voices Twist Queen, the LOL Doll.

Her song Shaboom is featured in a promo for the second season of Marvel's Agent Carter. She can be seen performing regularly with Quick & Funny Musicals.

IG: @randidemarco

rob-warner.name: Rob Warner
rob-warner.bioHtml:
Rob Warner is a Los Angeles-based actor, writer, comedian, singer, and lover of pizza.

Originally from Boston, Rob caught the acting bug early and starred in a number of local productions like The Music Man (Harold Hill), Fiddler on the Roof (Tevye), and The Tempest (Prospero). After singing a cappella at Brown University, Rob took a job in San Francisco at Google and worked in tech for five years before moving to Los Angeles to pursue acting and writing.

He performed in the Second City Premium show Trump in Space for two years and on the iO House sketch team Garden Party. He originated the role of Chris Harrison in Bachelor: The Unauthorized Musical Parody and Karentina in Real Housewives Unauthorized Musical Parody. He has published work in The Bold Italic and sung at Lincoln Center and Carnegie Hall.

Training includes Upright Citizens Brigade, Lesly Kahn, and The Groundlings for comedy, Mary Jo DuPrey for voice, and his mom. He can be seen in Quick & Funny Musicals in Los Angeles.

He has been singing and acting since he was 6 and hopes to one day live up to his most flattering stage name: Gay Seth Meyers.

Select Film & Television Credits: StoneFruit (2010), Addicted to You (2019), Ranchlands (2019)

IG: @robjustdoesthings

sean-meagher.name: Sean Meagher
sean-meagher.bioHtml:
Sean Meagher is overjoyed to be making his Edinburgh Fringe debut in this unbelievably silly musical! Originally moving to Los Angeles to work as a stop-motion animator, he created the award-winning short film A Slow Day For Doorman, then promptly said, “F*** this. I'm gonna do comedy instead.”

Now he can be seen performing regularly at the UCB Theater, where he produces and stars in the monthly live show Tabletop Tunes: The Improvised Musical RPG.

Select theater credits include Tosca (The Adrienne Arsht Center), Spelling Bee (Town Hall Theater), and Understood Betsy (The Actor's Playhouse), where he originated the role of Ralph.

Also, he can unicycle. We really should have worked that into this show...

IG: @seantoofar

shilpa-das.name: Shilpa Das
shilpa-das.bioHtml:
Shilpa Das is a comedian/writer/actor based in Los Angeles. She has performed standup at the Laugh Factory, The Comedy Store, and Flappers and has performed improv and musical improv with Asian AF, Sweet Sweet Fantasy, and Baby Wants Candy in Shamilton at Upright Citizens Brigade in Los Angeles.

Shilpa is the producer/co-host of LA's largest South Asian variety comedy show, South Asian AF.

IG: @shugd // theshilpadas.com

tara-cox.name: Tara Cox
tara-cox.bioHtml:
Tara Cox is a UCLA grad with a BA in Theatre and creator of musical parodies on TikTok that have been shared by Rosie O'Donnell, Leslie Jones, and Shania Twain, garnering over 1 million views and 30k+ followers.

She has 2 NAACP Theatre Award nominations for her roles as Dragon in Nocturne's Shrek and Lettie in the Wallis' world premiere of Rapunzel Alone.

She originated Mirabel in the off-ice VIP Pre-Show with Disney on Ice. She can be seen regularly on the Upright Citizens Brigade main stage performing improvised musicals with Sing Out, Louise and writing/performing with Quick & Funny Musicals.

IG: @taraalisecox

tony-gonzalez.name: Tony Gonzalez
tony-gonzalez.bioHtml:
Tony Gonzalez is a composer / musical director / accompanist / vocalist from Los Angeles. He is a sought-after musical director for improvised and written musicals throughout the city.

He holds a Bachelor of Music in Voice from Baylor University and a Master of Music in Voice from Indiana University.

Alongside longtime collaborator Sam Johnides, he has composed original music and parodies for various theatrical productions, including Missed Connections: A Craigslist Musical, Supportive White Parents, and unauthorized parodies of The Bachelor and Real Housewives.

Tony's music direction credits include It's a Wonderful Life: The Radio Play, The Devil's Bride, A Feast of Snacks, Pope! An Epic Musical, Theatrical Creations' Holiday Carolers, and Mirror-Mirror. Gonzalez and Johnides also co-founded the musical project Diary of Atticus, blending indie-pop with immersive theatrical and dance performances.

IG: @mister_8th_wonder

vasthy-mompoint.name: Vasthy Mompoint
vasthy-mompoint.bioHtml:
Vasthy Mompoint is an 8-time Broadway performer, choreographer, and the creator of Vasthy & Friends (formerly Vasthy's Friends), an interactive children's show that brings Broadway magic to families through original music, dance-alongs, and joyful cultural discovery.

Her Broadway credits include The Prom, SpongeBob SquarePants: The Broadway Musical, Rocky, Mary Poppins, and more.

Vasthy's screen credits include High School Musical: The Musical: The Series, NCIS, and The Bold and the Beautiful.

As a voice actor, she voices Briny the Whale on Nickelodeon's Baby Shark's Big Show! and can be heard in the Disney+ voice-over production Ariel Jr.

With a deep commitment to inclusion and emotional fluency, Vasthy creates experiences where every child feels seen, celebrated, and invited to play.

IG: @frostyvasthy

juanita-andersen.name: Juanita Andersen
juanita-andersen.bioHtml:
Juanita Andersen is a Salvadoran-American actor based in Los Angeles. She is SAG-Eligible and an Equity Membership Candidate.

Most recently Juanita starred as the romantic lead in the hit vertical series The Summer I Turned My Sexiest, which can be found on the Gammatime app. She also appears in the comedic webseries Clout Castle, as an aggressive and unhinged orc LARPER.

Juanita is a prolific commercial actor, and is always putting her Chicago iO improv training to great use in that space.

On stage, her Chicago credits include work with The Goodman Theatre, Victory Gardens, Teatro Vista, Griffin Theatre, Lifeline Theatre, Filament Theatre, Adventure Stage Chicago, and more. Regionally, she has worked with Williams Street Rep and Boise Contemporary Theater. Juanita can also be heard co-hosting Highlights Hangout, a podcast produced by Highlights for Children and Tinkercast. She is also a proud Emeritus company member with PlayMakers Laboratory. Juanita graduated with a BA degree in Theatre and Latinx Studies from Northwestern University.

Juanita is represented by Eris Talent Agency (Theatrical) and BBR Talent Agency (Commercial).

IG: @juanitaandersen_ // juanitaandersen.com

marie-lively.name: Marie Lively
marie-lively.bioHtml:
Marie Lively is an actor / voice over artist / singer / writer / producer / improviser. With almost 20 years of improv and sketch experience, Marie has always been active on the stage and on the page.

She was a member of the UCB Harold Team, The Dragons. She has a one woman show, True Hustle. She both writes and performs with Quick & Funny Musicals. When not on stage Marie is a writer, VO actor and devoted mother of two.

Representation:
Brandie Ilsen - brandie@deanpanarotalent.com (Voice Over)

IG: @livelymarie // marielively.com

mitchell-gerard-johnson.name: Mitchell Gerrard Johnson
mitchell-gerard-johnson.bioHtml:
Mitchell Gerrard Johnson is a singer / dancer / writer / choreographer / producer originally from Houston, Texas (Land of Beyoncé) but currently lives in Los Angeles. Mitchell graduated from Saint Louis University with a degree Marketing and Vocal Performance.

Mitchell has amassed a TikTok and Instagram following for their comedy drag and dance videos. Mitchell performs with Quick & Funny monthly.

Select credits: Sebastian in Mickey and the Magical Map (Disneyland), Pumba in Tale of the Lion King (Disneyland), The Minstrel in Something Rotten (5 Star Theatrical), Judah in Joseph and the Amazing Technicolored Dreamcoat (5 Star Theatrical), the Big Bad Wolf in Shrek (5 Star Theatrical), In the Heights as the assistant choreographer (Young Artist Ensemble).

Representation:
Stone Talent Agency - simone@stonetalentagency.com (Commercial)
Steven Dry - sdry@connorankrum.com (Musical Theater Agent)

IG: @mgjohns // TikTok: @mgjohns // mitchellgerrardjohnson.com

nour-hajar.name: Nour Hajar
nour-hajar.bioHtml:
Nour Hajar (they/them) is an writer / director / actor / improviser. They studied at NYU's Tisch School of the Arts and the Experimental Theater Wing, earning a BFA in Drama with a minor in Cinema Studies.

They've also studied improv at the Upright Citizens Brigade and People's Improv Theater in New York. They can be seen performing monthly on UCB's musical house team Small Town Mayor and with Quick & Funny Musicals.

IG: @itsnourhajar // nourhajar.com

tristan-turner.name: Tristan Turner
tristan-turner.bioHtml:
Tristan Turner is an actor / writer / singer / songwriter / voice coach. He is known for his performance of Miles Gordon in The Residence (Netflix) and film The Travel Companion which premiered at Tribeca last year. You can find some of his original music on Spotify under his recording name HUDO.

Select Regional: Twelfth Night, Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat (Utah Shakespeare Festival); A Midsummer Night’s Dream, A Winter’s Tale (New Swan Shakespeare Festival)

IG: @tristanturn // TikTok: @turnerhudo

alana-gospodnetich.name: Alana Gospodnetich
alana-gospodnetich.bioHtml:
Alana Gospodnetich is an actor, writer, and producer. She has screen credits including White Whines, A Date Us Halloween, Sheryl by Sheryl, Donna’s Inferno, and voice work in Final Fantasy VII Remake and Tig N’ Seek.

In addition to her entertainment work, Alana now works as a real estate agent.

IG: @alanagospo

benjamin-siemon.name: Benjamin Siemon
benjamin-siemon.bioHtml:
Benjamin Siemon is a writer, actor, improviser, and puppeteer whose work stretches from live comedy to television animation and musical theater. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Ben has long been a presence in the UCB world, with credits including Maude team Bonafide, Harold teams Elroy and Hey, Uncle Gary!, Freak Dance: The Forbidden Dirty Boogaloo, and his two-man improv team Small Town Sheriff.

On screen, Ben is known for Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Adam Ruins Everything, and Freak Dance. As a writer, he has built an especially strong career in animation, with credits including DuckTales, Trolls: TrollsTopia, This Duckburg Life, Tiny Toons: Looniversity, Chibiverse, and Broken Karaoke. He is also an experienced puppeteer who performs in Jim Henson’s improvised puppet show Puppet Up!.

IG: @bjsiemon // bensiemon.com

brian-glidewell.name: Brian Glidewell
brian-glidewell.bioHtml:
Brian Glidewell is a writer, actor, comedian, and musician whose work spans film, comedy, and original music. He is a trained improviser who performed on the Upright Citizens Brigade Harold team RAGNARÖCK.

Brian wrote the short film Boystown, a comedy that was also selected for the New York Television Festival. He also maintains a music presence online through SoundCloud, where his original work reflects the same wit and offbeat voice that shows up in his comedy writing.

IG: @brianglidewell // brianglidewell.com

chris-grace.name: Chris Grace
chris-grace.bioHtml:
Chris Grace is an actor, writer, comedian, and musical comedy performer whose work spans television, live performance, and solo theater. As a Quick & Funny Musicals alum, he is part of the company’s long-running comedy-theater tradition, with roots in musical improv and sharp character-driven comedy.

Chris is also known for his work with Baby Wants Candy and as a co-writer of Thrones! The Musical Parody, the hit stage spoof that grew into an international cult favorite. In recent years, he has expanded his audience through work with Dropout, including Chris Grace: As Scarlett Johansson and appearances across the platform’s comedy world. His solo work has also found major success at the Edinburgh Fringe, including acclaimed one-person shows such as Sardines.

On screen, Chris is known for Superstore, Broad City, This Is Us, and Under the Silver Lake, along with a wide range of television and comedy work.

IG: @chrisgracecomedy // chrisgrace.com

chrissy-bruzek.name: Chrissy Bruzek
chrissy-bruzek.bioHtml:
Chrissy Bruzek is a performer, writer, musician, and producer whose work spans comedy, music, and post-production. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Chrissy has a background in improv, sketch, and musical sketch comedy, bringing a sharp comic sensibility and strong musical instincts to her work onstage.

In addition to performing, Chrissy is a classically trained singer and played viola for 12 years. Her screen credits include projects such as Kars4Kids: The E! True Hollywood Story, Soundman, and Wishful Thinking. She also works professionally as a post producer in Los Angeles, with a background in motion graphics, editorial, CG, finishing, and 2D/3D graphics.

Chrissy’s work reflects a blend of comedy, musicianship, and behind-the-scenes creative craft that makes her a versatile presence in original performance work.

IG: @chrissybru // TikTok: @chrissybruzek // chrissybruzek.com

eric-michaud.name: Eric Michaud
eric-michaud.bioHtml:
Eric Michaud is an actor, singer, choreographer, and director whose work has taken him from musical comedy stages to major international venues.

As a performer, Eric has appeared around the world, including at the Sydney Opera House, where he brought the house down with his performance as Hodor in Thrones! The Musical Parody. He has also performed across the UK as Hagrid in Voldemort and the Teenage Hogwarts Musical Parody. As a choreographer, he won a regional BroadwayWorld Award for Teaching a Robot to Love. He has also built a strong directing career, including directing Chris Grace’s Sardines and Chris Grace: As Scarlett Johansson.

IG: @theaterbear

eugene-cordero.name: Eugene Cordero
eugene-cordero.bioHtml:
Eugene Cordero is an actor, writer, and comedian whose work spans television, film, voice acting, and live comedy. Eugene is a regular performer and veteran at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theater. As a Quick & Funny Musicals alum, he is part of the company’s long comedy-theater lineage, bringing the same sharp comic instincts to screen and stage work alike.

He is widely known for playing Casey on Loki, Sam Rutherford on Star Trek: Lower Decks, and Andy Myawani on Tacoma FD. His additional credits include The Good Place, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Wrecked, Bajillion Dollar Propertie$, and films including Kong: Skull Island, The Mule, and The Kings of Summer. Eugene’s work is marked by an instantly likable screen presence, grounded comedy, and a talent for making even the wildest characters feel specific and human.

IG: @eugcordero

fiona-landers.name: Fiona Landers
fiona-landers.bioHtml:
Fiona Landers was almost born in a yellow 1964 Ford Thunderbird convertible, but her parents made it to the birth center in Culver City just in time. She studied acting and singing at Circle in the Square Theatre School in New York City, guitar and composition at the New York Conservatory of Music, and Shakespeare at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art in London.

Fiona has performed her original songs throughout New York and Los Angeles at venues including Bowery Ballroom, Rockwood Music Hall, Highline Ballroom, Hotel Cafe, and the Bootleg Theatre. She has also worked in comedy videos, film, and television, with credits including Burn Notice, The UCB Show, The Hotwives of Las Vegas, CollegeHumor Originals, and Unicorn Store. She also co-wrote Voldemort and the Teenage Hogwarts Musical Parody.

She began studying at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre Los Angeles in 2009 and went on to perform in numerous shows there, including Maude Night, Quick & Funny Musicals, Diamond Lion, The Sunshine Gang, Mixtape, Smug Rock Nation, Christmas Tonight with Santa Clause, Let’s Do This, Not Too Shabby, Princess Fiona and the Apple, and Fiona Landers: Paradise Valley.

IG: @fionalanders // fionalanders.com

greg-smith.name: Greg L. Smith
greg-smith.bioHtml:
Greg L. Smith is an award-winning director, writer, actor, musician, and songwriter from Detroit. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Greg has built a comedy career that moves easily between sketch, improv, live performance, and screen work.

His directorial work has played festivals, been featured in Vulture, and earned a Vimeo Staff Pick. He has written for Shudder’s The Core and CBS’s The Recruit, acted in projects including Hollywood Darlings and The Late Late Show with James Corden, and written songs for CollegeHumor and G4. He currently writes for the UCB Maude team The Family Business and is also a veteran musical improviser and freestyle hip-hop improviser, performing with his musical improv team Candy Apple Red and hip-hop team Dopetown 3000. He is also an accomplished pianist and music director for stage and improv.

IG: @smithlgreg // smithlgreg.com

j-elaine-marcos.name: J. Elaine Marcos
j-elaine-marcos.bioHtml:
J. Elaine Marcos is a Broadway performer, actor, writer, and comedian known for her impeccable comic timing and scene-stealing performances. Originally from Burlington, Ontario, J. Elaine grew up as a Filipina-Canadian kid who loved performing and laughter, and she eventually turned that passion into a career across Broadway, film, television, and comedy.

Her Broadway credits include Annie, where she starred as Lily St. Regis opposite Jane Lynch, Priscilla Queen of the Desert as Cynthia, A Chorus Line, The Wedding Singer, Flower Drum Song, Sweet Charity, Wonderful Town, Miss Saigon, and Gettin’ the Band Back Together. Her work in Priscilla Queen of the Desert earned her an Astaire Award nomination for Excellence in Dance. On screen, she has appeared in Morning Glory, St. Vincent, Rent: Live, The Lion Guard, Law & Order: SVU, and Grace and Frankie.

In addition to her stage and screen work, J. Elaine creates her own comedy, including her long-running Motivational Mondays with “V” series, bringing together the singing, dancing, acting, and comedic instincts of a true Broadway original.

IG: @jelainemarcos // jelainemarcos.org

jacquis-neal.name: Jacquis Neal
jacquis-neal.bioHtml:
Jacquis Neal is an actor, comedian, host, and podcaster whose work spans television, voice acting, live comedy, and digital media. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Jacquis brings a sharp comedic voice and an easy onstage charisma to everything from scripted performance to improv and hosting.

He is known for playing Damion on NBC’s Grand Crew and has also appeared in Last Week Tonight with John Oliver, Physical, How I Met Your Father, and Liza on Demand. Jacquis is also a major presence in the Dropout comedy world, where he hosts Crowd Control and appears on shows including Make Some Noise, Thousandaires, and Kingpin Katie.

In addition to his screen work, Jacquis is a longtime comedy performer and podcaster, including hosting and producing shows with iHeartRadio, Headgum, and Earwolf/SiriusXM. He is also the host of Comedian Feud at the Elysian Theater and performs regularly at UCB, building a career that moves fluidly between performance, writing, and comedy hosting.

IG: @jacquisneal // jacquisneal.com

jeff-hiller.name: Jeff Hiller
jeff-hiller.bioHtml:
Jeff Hiller is an actor, comedian, and longtime musical improviser whose work spans television, theater, and live comedy. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Jeff was a longtime performer at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre, where he performed musical improv with Diamond Lion and became a familiar presence in the UCB comedy world.

He is also well known for performing with Baby Wants Candy, one of the most celebrated musical improv ensembles in the country. Jeff is an Emmy Award-winning actor for his performance as Joel on Somebody Somewhere, and his additional television credits include 30 Rock, Broad City, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Community, Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt, and American Horror Story: NYC.

Onstage, Jeff appeared Off-Broadway in Silence! The Musical, along with productions including Bloody Bloody Andrew Jackson. His work is marked by a singular mix of warmth, specificity, and comic precision that has made him a standout in both musical comedy and character acting.

IG: @boomboomhiller // hillertime.com

jessica-reiner-harris.name: Jessica Reiner-Harris
jessica-reiner-harris.bioHtml:
Jessica Reiner-Harris is an actress, writer, producer, singer, vocal impersonator, and improviser with a bright comic energy and a love of wordplay, Broadway sing-alongs, and unabashed geekery. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, she brings warmth, wit, and a distinctly playful point of view to her work onstage and on screen.

Her credits include Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Living with Models, Monday Afternoon Live, and The Week. She also co-wrote Law & Order: The Musical! and served as a writer, performer, and executive producer on Monday Afternoon Live. Jessica’s performance style blends character comedy, strong musical instincts, and a voice that can jump from heartfelt to hilariously heightened in an instant.

IG: @jessreinerharris // warmthandwit

john-loos.name: John Loos
john-loos.bioHtml:
John Loos is an actor, writer, and sketch/improv comedian with more than 20 years of experience. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, John is known for a comedy voice that is sharp, character-driven, and gloriously queer.

He started improvising at the University of Illinois before moving to Chicago, where he trained at Second City and iO, performed with Second City at Sea on three NCL ships, and became an ensemble member of GayCo Productions. He also wrote plays for The Annoyance, including Earthqueef and A Woman’s Path, and later created and starred in multiple web series. In Los Angeles, he has continued writing and performing with the sketch duo Pinque Pony while also building creative and corporate storytelling work through The Pinquelton Group.

John’s work is marked by big comic characters, strong writing, and a distinct point of view that has made him a memorable presence across live comedy, sketch, and original digital work.

IG/TikTok: @johnlooswins // johnlooscomedy.com

joseph-porter.name: Joseph Porter
joseph-porter.bioHtml:
Joe Porter is a writer, actor, director, and musician. Before moving to Los Angeles, Porter studied acting at the Moscow Art Theatre and DePaul University, later graduating summa cum laude from Wayne State University.

His credits include DreamWorksTV, Peacock Kids, the CBS Diversity Showcase, Maude Night, and Quick & Funny Musicals at UCB, where he has written, directed, and performed. His writing credits also include the live-action/animated hybrid series Dr. G’s Superhero Workshop and the animated kids’ series Spine-Chilling Stories. On screen, his acting work includes Truth and Lies, Connect, and Detention of the Dead.

Alongside his television and theater work, Joe is a guitarist for the band Hot Carl and The Cleveland Steamers.

IG: @sephporter

kathryn-burns.name: Kathryn Burns
kathryn-burns.bioHtml:
Kathryn Burns is an Emmy Award-winning choreographer, director, performer, and a founding member of Quick & Funny Musicals. She helped shape the company’s early UCB roots and remains an important part of its creative history.

Kathryn is best known for her choreography on Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, which earned her Emmy recognition and helped define some of the most inventive musical storytelling on television. Her additional credits include choreographing Pharrell Williams’ “Happy”, directing and performing with the cast of Crazy Ex-Girlfriend Live at Radio City Music Hall, and co-producing/choreographing Yes, It’s Really Us Singing: The Crazy Ex-Girlfriend Concert Special. Her work is known for marrying character, comedy, and movement with precision.

She occasionally returns to perform with Quick & Funny Musicals and directed the company’s show Pun-Off.

IG: @katmburns // thekathrynburns.com

lindsey-lefler.name: Lindsey Lefler
lindsey-lefler.bioHtml:
Lindsey Lefler is a theater producer, director, improviser, and arts leader whose work has helped shape comedy and live performance communities across Southern California. Born in Japan and raised in England before settling in the United States, Lindsey fell in love with musical theater early and performed in more than 20 musicals growing up before discovering that her deeper passion was creating the work as well as performing in it.

She studied theater direction at UC Irvine, where she co-founded the improv group Live Nude People… With Clothes On, and later helped build Improv Shmimprov into a staple of the Orange County improv scene. After moving to Los Angeles, Lindsey joined the opening team at REDCAT in Walt Disney Concert Hall before becoming a key force at Upright Citizens Brigade, where she helped launch the Los Angeles theater, served in leadership roles including general manager and head of operations, and produced Quick & Funny Musicals through more than a decade of sold-out performances. She also directed the stage version of Freak Dance, which was later adapted into a feature film.

Today, Lindsey serves as Managing Director of Theatre West, continuing her work creating spaces where artists can take risks, collaborate, and thrive.

IG: @lindslef

maddi-fraser.name: Maddi Fraser
maddi-fraser.bioHtml:
Maddi Fraser is a singer, musician, and performer known for her soulful voice and magnetic stage presence. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Maddi brings a rich musicality to her performance work, blending theatrical instinct with the kind of powerhouse vocal style that can shift easily from comedy to full emotional sweep.

Maddi appeared on Season 16 of NBC’s The Voice and has toured and performed with a range of artists and projects. She can also be heard on Spotify and Apple Music, and has performed both as a lead vocalist and as a featured collaborator across multiple recordings. In addition to her stage and music work in Los Angeles, Maddi is bringing her one-woman Stevie Nicks show Stevie Nicks: The Gypsy That I Was to the Edinburgh Fringe.

Whether singing lead, harmonizing in a band, or stepping into character-driven musical work, Maddi is known for a voice that is warm, powerful, and unmistakably her own.

IG: @themaddifraser // maddifrasermusic.wixsite.com/maddi-fraser

meghan-parks.name: Meghan Parks
meghan-parks.bioHtml:
Meghan Parks is an actress and comedian born and raised in Los Angeles. Since the age of six, Meghan has been performing in a wide range of settings and has built a career around character work, musical theater, and making people laugh.

Her credits include the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre LA, iO West, The Improv, The Laugh Factory, Funny or Die, SF Sketchfest, NY Fringe Fest, and The Comedy Central Stage. In addition to her performance work, Meghan hosts Morning with Meghan, a podcast centered on life, mental health, and how weird things can get.

IG: @meghanparks

muriel-montgomery.name: Muriel Montgomery
muriel-montgomery.bioHtml:
Muriel Montgomery is an actor, writer, producer, and improvisor who has built her career through theater, comedy, and self-produced creative work. She started performing in local theater in Seattle as a child, later moved to Chicago to study improv at iO, and was cast on both a Harold team there and the long-running musical house team The DelTones.

After moving to Los Angeles, Muriel joined the company of Quick & Funny Musicals and was also cast on the improv team KAREN. Alongside her husband Nick, she co-created the award-winning mockumentary web series Fam Club, which won several festival awards, and they have continued building creative work together through podcasting and independent production. Muriel also co-hosts the true crime/comedy podcast Muriel’s Murders, bringing her sharp comedic voice into a very different kind of storytelling space.

Her work reflects a love of performance, collaboration, and making your own opportunities when the usual path doesn’t quite fit.

IG: @therealmurielmontgomery

nate-clark.name: Nate Clark
nate-clark.bioHtml:
Nate Clark is a performer, writer, producer, and political media strategist whose work spans comedy, podcasting, and communications. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Nate has built a career that moves between live performance and public-facing political work, bringing the same smart, audience-savvy instincts to both.

As a performer, Nate has appeared with The Groundlings and in live comedy and improvised work in Los Angeles, and he hosts The Nate Clark Show podcast. His IMDb credits also include projects such as Hollywood Darlings, Somewhere in Palm Springs, and the satire short Paul Ryan Changes His Mind, which he wrote, directed, and starred in.

In addition to his entertainment work, Nate has built a strong parallel career in political communications and media strategy, including research and writing on the political effects of broadcast presentation and messaging.

IG: @nateclarkshow // nateclark.net

philip-labes.name: Philip Labes
philip-labes.bioHtml:
Philip Labes is a singer-songwriter, comedian, composer, and musical improviser whose work bridges indie music, original comedy songs, and live musical theater. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Philip is also a veteran musical improviser, including work with Baby Wants Candy and his own improvised musical podcast The Musical Version.

Philip is also a recording artist with a growing audience for his original songs on Instagram, TikTok, and Spotify. His work as a writer and composer includes More Guns!, now titled Good Guy With a Gun, a musical comedy created with Micah O’Konis that has been recorded as a full-length concept album starring Anthony Rapp, Chris Sullivan, Kimiko Glenn, Kristen Schall, and Vic Michaelis.

He toured with Jason Mraz, an experience chronicled in the documentary The Opener, and his additional screen credits include Watchmen, Lucifer, Minx, The OA, and Dropout’s Play It by Ear. Across music, comedy, and performance, Philip brings a style that is both emotionally grounded and sharply funny.

IG: @philiplabes // philiplabes.com

rachel-bloom.name: Rachel Bloom
rachel-bloom.bioHtml:
Rachel Bloom is an Emmy, Golden Globe, and Critics Choice Award-winning writer, actor, comedian, songwriter, and producer, and a founding member of Quick & Funny Musicals. Before Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Rachel got her start at the Upright Citizens Brigade, where she created and performed live musical sketch comedy and helped build the kind of comedy-musical work that would later define her career. Her roots in that fast, funny, theatrical UCB world are part of the DNA of Quick & Funny Musicals.

She is best known as the co-creator and star of Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, the acclaimed musical dramedy that brought her singular blend of comedy, songwriting, and emotional precision to a wide audience. She first gained major attention through her viral musical comedy videos, including Fuck Me, Ray Bradbury, and has continued to build a career across television, film, live performance, and musical theater writing.

Additional credits include Rachel Bloom: Death, Let Me Do My Special on Netflix, voice work in Trolls World Tour, and music and lyrics work for The Nanny musical adaptation. Her work is marked by fearless specificity, musical wit, and a deep love of comedy that takes performance seriously.

IG: @racheldoesstuff // racheldoesstuff.com

richie-root.name: Richie Root
richie-root.bioHtml:
Richie Root is a writer, actor, and comedian based in California. His work leans into character comedy, parody, and musical theater, with credits both onstage and in screen comedy.

Richie co-wrote Voldemort and the Teenage Hogwarts Musical Parody, which later played internationally and found a strong following with musical-comedy audiences. His IMDb credits also include writing for Tvoovies, where he voiced multiple characters, and acting work across comedy projects.

IG: @richieroot__ // richieroot.com

scott-passarella.name: Scott Passarella
scott-passarella.bioHtml:
Scott Passarella is a composer, performer, educator, pianist, and music director from California. He began learning improv through ComedySportz LA, where he performs on the mainstage, and has built a wide-ranging career accompanying and shaping musical comedy onstage and off.

As a music director, Scott has played for Quick & Funny Musicals at UCB, The Second City’s Touring Company, The Made-Up Game Show with Wayne Brady, and Story Pirates, in addition to many shows at the UCB Theater, The Improv Comedy Lab, Comedy Central Stage, iO West, and the Groundlings. He is also the pianist and band director for Off Book: The Improvised Musical Podcast, where he is often lovingly referred to as the King of Pianists, Pianist of Kings.

Scott has also composed songs for Second City revues, podcasts, sketches, and more than thirty one-act plays, while continuing to teach improv and musical improvisation.

IG: @scottpassarella // scottpassarella.com

steve-szlaga.name: Steve Szlaga
steve-szlaga.bioHtml:
Steve Szlaga is a writer, performer, and improviser from Michigan whose comedy work has taken him through UCB, The Groundlings, television writing, and character-driven screen performance.

He is half of the sketch duo Medium Friends and has written for The Powerpuff Girls, MyMusic, and Staged. On screen, his credits include CollegeHumor Originals, Hollywood Darlings, and Hacks. Steve’s work balances sharp sketch writing with an easy performance style that plays equally well in live comedy and on camera.

IG: @szzzzlaga

stuart-wood.name: Stuart Wood
stuart-wood.bioHtml:
Stuart Wood is a pianist, music director, composer, writer, and teacher based in Cleethorpes. He writes for theatre, film, and commercials, including the original Go Compare adverts, and has built a career around creating music for both the stage and screen.

His stage work includes musicals such as Frank’s Closet, and he is also a familiar presence at piano events, sessions, and live performance spaces. Alongside his composing work, Stuart teaches and continues developing new projects that reflect both his theatrical instincts and his gift for melody.

IG: @stuiewood // stuartwoodmusic.wordpress.com

taylor-cox.name: Taylor Cox
taylor-cox.bioHtml:
Taylor Cox is a writer, comedian, and performer whose work spans television, live comedy, and humor writing. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Taylor has built a sharp, character-driven comedic voice across both scripted television and live performance.

Her television writing credits include Girls5eva, Only Murders in the Building, and The Thrilling Adventure Hour, along with Miracle Workers, Single Parents, Abby’s, and animation work for Netflix, Hulu, and DreamWorksTV. In addition to her screen work, Taylor’s humor writing has appeared in McSweeney’s, The New Yorker, and Reductress, and she has performed stand-up at venues including the Laugh Factory.

Taylor’s work is marked by smart joke writing, strong comic perspective, and a voice that moves easily between television, essays, and live comedy.

IG: @imtaylorcox

tess-paras.name: Tess Paras
tess-paras.bioHtml:
Tess Paras is an actor, writer, director, and musical comedy performer whose work spans television, digital comedy, and original film projects. As a Quick & Funny Musicals alum, she is part of the company’s musical-comedy lineage, bringing sharp comic instincts and a strong background in performance and writing to the stage.

Tess is known for her recurring role as Jayma Chan-Epstein on the Emmy Award-winning musical comedy Crazy Ex-Girlfriend. She also recurred on Just Add Magic and became a series regular on the Daytime Emmy-nominated spinoff Just Add Magic: Mystery City. In addition to her on-camera work, Tess has built an impressive directing career, including the short films Perry and a Pause and A New You, as well as directing the ViacomCBS Showcase.

Her work bridges acting, directing, and musical comedy, with credits across television, shorts, and live performance.

IG: @tessparas // tessparas.com

tony-rodriguez.name: Tony Rodriguez
tony-rodriguez.bioHtml:
Tony Rodriguez is an actor, writer, comedian, and longtime Upright Citizens Brigade performer whose work spans television, sketch, live comedy, and musical parody. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, he has built a career rooted in character work, comedy writing, and performance.

Tony is especially known for voicing Julio Franco on The Simpsons, an openly gay recurring character whose recasting was widely noted as a meaningful step in LGBTQ representation on the show. His screen credits also include Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Gentefied, Adam Ruins Everything, Conan, Playing House, and the Emmy-winning web series Eastsiders. He also wrote for and performed in CBS’s Sketch Diversity Showcase.

Onstage, Tony performed in Real Housewives Unauthorized Musical Parody, adding another strong musical-comedy credit to his body of work.

IG: @thetonyrodrig

zach-reino.name: Zach Reino
zach-reino.bioHtml:
Zach Reino is an actor, writer, comedian, and musical improviser whose work is deeply rooted in original musical comedy. A Quick & Funny Musicals alum, Zach is especially known for co-creating and co-hosting Off Book: The Improvised Musical Podcast with his longtime comedy partner Jessica McKenna, a beloved showcase for fully improvised musical storytelling.

He is also a member of Baby Wants Candy and co-wrote Thrones! The Musical Parody, helping create one of the best-known stage spoofs in contemporary comedy theater. He also co-wrote Voldemort and the Teenage Hogwarts Musical Parody. More recently, Zach co-created the new musical comedy Three Months Later with Jessica McKenna and David Wain, a production that featured performers including Kristen Bell and Lea Thompson.

Zach is also a familiar presence in the Dropout comedy world, including Play It by Ear and The Official Cast Recording, and his additional screen credits include Brews Brothers, A.P. Bio, and Curb Your Enthusiasm.

IG: @zachreino // thezachandthejess.com
